editorial.name: Armadillo
editorial.descriptionZh: 订阅制的房屋保修（home warranty）公司，家电和暖气、电路、水管出问题时报修并报销，官方把 4.7 星 Google 评分当成首屏卖点。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看保险落地页怎么用报修故事做信任区
editorial.noteZh: 首屏米白底，导航 Homeowners / Realtors / Partners / Blog / About 排在左，中间是橙色手写体的 Armadillo 字标，右边 Service 与 Log in。主标题衬线大字 Welcome to a new age of home warranty.，副标题 Affordable, subscription-based protection for when appliances and systems break down in your home.，下面一个 Enter Zip Code 输入框配深紫色 Get Free Quote 按钮。主视觉下方是一整幅插画：一只橙色犰狳驮着一栋白房子，背景是蓝天、黄云和绿树，左下角挂着一枚黄色的 WHAT IS HOME WARRANTY 圆形徽章。往下是 The (almost) 5 star home warranty company 段，把 Justin Vetter、Joel Richman、Armando and Michelle、David Maez、Anna Werb、Seth Elalouf 六条带引号的报修故事并排铺开，再往下按 Heating & Cooling、Electrical、Plumbing、Kitchen Appliances、Laundry Appliances 五类拆分。
editorial.pricing: Paid - 首页写 Affordable, subscription-based protection，档位在 /pricing-plans；另有 Get Free Quote 按邮编询价
